sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 5.4 x 5.4 x 12.7 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

DPA 4060-BM specification sheet (a Thomann-hosted copy) downloaded and read as text 2026-11-12: omnidirectional condenser, "Microphone diameter 5.4 mm, Microphone length 12.7 mm", 7.5 g including cable and MicroDot connector, connector MicroDot; "for a wireless microphone, choose between our adapter system or a hardwired connector", adapters for most wireless systems, four colours (black, brown, beige, white). The plan notes (DPA product page) list MicroLock, TA4F mini-XLR, 3-pin LEMO and mini-jack terminations. Reassigned from the family `assembly` (deferred) to `revolve`: a lavalier capsule is a plain lathe. One port `out-ta4` (mini-xlr-ta4, the TA4F option) stands in for the chosen termination: the connector set depends on the order option, so the ports are NOT documented and the device is beta-modelled only (the capsule itself ends in a MicroDot, which the catalogue lacks). The port sits on the capsule base although the connector is at the end of a 1.8 m cable. The profile is our estimate (a rounded grid end); the body is the stated 5.4 x 12.7 mm. Black chosen from the four colours. Generic wrap artwork only.
